title: Authologic vs Veriff | Identity verification comparison
summary: Authologic vs Veriff: eID-first identity infrastructure vs automated document and selfie checks, compared on eIDs, EUDI Wallet, liveness and pricing.
body_markdown:
*eID-first identity infrastructure compared with automated document and selfie verification.*


Authologic and Veriff start identity verification from opposite ends. Authologic leads with national eIDs, bank IDs and digital identity wallets and falls back to document and selfie checks. Veriff specialises in automated document verification, biometric matching and liveness checks. Authologic fits businesses moving to eID-first onboarding under eIDAS 2.0 and the EU AMLR; Veriff fits businesses that verify mainly with identity documents.
